title: Label-free imaging and analysis of subcellular parts of a living diatom cylindrotheca sp. using optical diffraction tomography
author: Umemura, Matsukawa, et al.

steps.title: Prepare live diatom culture
steps.instruction: Collect an aliquot of seawater from the Katase‑Enoshima area, dilute it into Guillard f/2 culture medium, and incubate the mixture for several weeks at 20 °C.

steps.title: Load sample into imaging dish
steps.instruction: Inject an appropriate volume of the incubated seawater containing living Cylindrotheca sp. diatoms into a TomoDish (Tomocube Inc., Daejeon, South Korea) for direct observation.

steps.title: Configure HT imaging system
steps.instruction: Place the TomoDish on the HT‑2 instrument (Tomocube Inc., Daejeon, South Korea), immerse the water‑immersion objective lens in water (not in culture medium), and note the system’s theoretical spatial resolution of 110 nm lateral and 360 nm axial.

steps.title: Validate HT with latex beads
steps.instruction: Prepare a sample of 6 µm‑diameter latex beads (catalog 19102‑2, Polysciences, Inc., Warrington, PA), image them with the HT‑2, reconstruct RI tomograms, calculate the average RI (1.594 ± 0.001, n = 61) and confirm it matches the manufacturer’s value (1.5983).

steps.title: Image living diatom cell
steps.instruction: Using the HT‑2, acquire a three‑dimensional RI tomogram of a living Cylindrotheca sp. diatom; set the lateral field of view to 58.6 µm × 58.6 µm.

steps.title: Segment tomogram into subcellular parts
steps.instruction: From the reconstructed RI tomogram, extract four sub‑volumes based on the following RI ranges: black (1.352–1.357) for frustule, green (1.363–1.381) for protoplasm, blue (1.388–1.395) for vacuole, and red (1.403–1.436) for chloroplast.

steps.title: Quantify subcellular metrics
steps.instruction:
For each extracted sub‑volume compute the parameters listed in Table 1:

- **Black (frustule)**: Min RI = 1.352, Max RI = 1.357, Volume = 147.467 µm³, Volume of color = 38.438 µm³, Surface area = 288.556 µm², Projected area = 57.208 µm², Mean RI = 1.3878, Concentration = 0.2849 pg/µm³, Dry mass = 42.006 pg, Dry mass of color = 4.587 pg, Sphericity = 0.4678, Threshold RI = 1.352.
- **Green (protoplasm)**: Min RI = 1.363, Max RI = 1.381, Volume = 109.029 µm³, Volume of color = 145.678 µm³, Surface area = 819.579 µm², Projected area = 443.505 µm², Mean RI = 1.3989, Concentration = 0.3432 pg/µm³, Dry mass = 837.419 pg, Dry mass of color = 49.858 pg, Sphericity = 0.5586, Threshold RI = 1.363.
- **Blue (vacuole)**: Min RI = 1.388, Max RI = 1.395, Volume = 363.351 µm³, Volume of color = 20.816 µm³, Surface area = 5145.007 µm², Projected area = 133.199 µm², Mean RI = 1.4164, Concentration = 0.4351 pg/µm³, Dry mass = 427.561 pg, Dry mass of color = 36.645 pg, Sphericity = 0.5300, Threshold RI = 1.388.
- **Red (chloroplast)**: Min RI = 1.403, Max RI = 1.436, Volume = 342.534 µm³, Volume of color = 44.534 µm³, Surface area = 945.007 µm², Projected area = 26.557 µm², Mean RI = 1.4271, Concentration = 0.4917 pg/µm³, Dry mass = 120.915 pg, Dry mass of color = 0.915 pg, Sphericity = 0.5128, Threshold RI = 1.403.
